    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    Is=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==5]
    r0=min(i for i,j in Is); r1=max(i for i,j in Is)

    ms=[(v,i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v not in (0,5) and (i<r0 or i>r1 or j<c0 or j>c1)]

    for i in range(r0+1,r1):
        for j in range(c0+1,c1):
